description: The runtime theme system layered on FEAT-001's theme-core: ThemeProvider (prefs source of truth after hydration, DB + localStorage persistence), the Appearance panel (mode, accent picker + presets, optional bg/surface tints, Reset to default, ContrastWarning), the gear/palette entry in the Header, system-mode matchMedia live re-resolution, and the esbuild bootstrap PARITY test. Realizes acceptance criterion 4 (theme is per-user, survives refresh, works in both modes) and completes criterion 5 (WCAG). Depends on FEAT-001 (theme-core, tokens.css, bootstrap plugin) and FEAT-002 (SessionProvider for logged-in DB persistence via Policy A).
steps: Create src/lib/theme.ts: app-facing helpers over theme-core (apply resolved tokens to document.documentElement via setProperty; resolve 'system' via matchMedia; the cb-theme localStorage read/write with the SAME shape the inline bootstrap parses).

Create src/context/ThemeProvider.tsx: holds ThemePrefs; on mount hydrates from profile.theme_preferences (if logged in) else localStorage else DEFAULT_PREFS. ALWAYS write cb-theme to localStorage on change. If logged in, ALSO persist to profiles.theme_preferences via update({ theme_preferences }).eq('id', uid) (allowed by Policy A — role unchanged). On login, DB prefs win over localStorage then sync localStorage to match; if DB empty, push localStorage up. Anonymous: localStorage only, no DB row. 'system' mode subscribes to matchMedia and re-resolves live. Applies resolved tokens on every change.

Create src/components/AppearancePanel.tsx (opened from a gear/palette icon in Header; available to everyone): Mode Light/Dark/System selector; accent color picker + a few presets; optional background tint + surface tint (presets or picker); 'Reset to default' button (clears tints, accent back to amber, mode back to system, writes both stores — DB only if logged in — and re-applies). Validate hex /^#([0-9a-fA-F]{6})$/; reject invalid keeping previous value. All controls are real <button>/<input> with visible focus. Create src/components/ContrastWarning.tsx.

Wire the contrast guards into the Appearance panel: when adjustForAA falls back to --text for --accent-text, show the ContrastWarning ('This accent isn't readable as link text in {mode} mode; links use the default text color'). When a bg/surface tint drops --text below AA 4.5 against the tinted bg/surface, warn and offer one-click discard-tint (keep base). Add the gear/palette entry button to Header.tsx.

Add the bootstrap PARITY test (fix per design round-2 #2): in a Vitest test, re-run esbuild.build({ entryPoints:['src/lib/theme-core.ts'], bundle:true, format:'iife', globalName:'CBTheme', write:false, ... }), eval the resulting IIFE string in a jsdom/VM context to obtain the inlined CBTheme.resolveTokens, and assert it returns token maps byte-identical to the directly-imported runtime resolveTokens for a fixed prefs set (default; custom accent; light tint; dark + accent). This catches both math drift and parse-time/dangling-identifier breakage in the inline script.

Add theme-core/contrast unit tests: relativeLuminance + contrastRatio against WCAG reference pairs (black/white = 21:1; #FFB547 vs black vs white); pickReadable picks the higher-ratio color; adjustForAA mid-tone passes unchanged, too-light-in-light-mode darkens to pass, saturated accent exhausts 50 steps and returns --text (fix #5: verify --accent-text is computed once against BOTH --bg and --surface and falls back to --text when neither passes); resolveTokens expected maps for dark/light, accent overlay, tint overlay, and mode-switch preserving the accent. Add a computational assertion that the DEFAULT dark and light palettes meet WCAG AA for --text and --muted on their surfaces (criterion 5).
Commit locally on branch classboard via git -C c:\Users\paulc\Projects\ToDoS\.worktrees\classboard. Never push.
acceptance_criteria: Changing the theme affects only the current user: logged-in persists to their own profiles.theme_preferences (Policy A) + localStorage; anonymous persists to localStorage only; it survives a refresh and works in both light and dark mode (criterion 4).
The accent is stored once and applied on top of whichever base palette is active, so switching Light<->Dark keeps the accent.
--accent-text is computed ONCE against both --bg and --surface, falling back to --text with a ContrastWarning when neither passes (fix #5); tint-vs-text AA warnings offer discard-tint.
The parity test evaluates the ACTUAL esbuild IIFE string and asserts byte-identical token maps vs runtime resolveTokens for the fixed prefs set.
Reset to default restores amber/system/no-tint and re-applies; Appearance panel is reachable from a gear/palette icon; all controls are real <button>/<input> with visible focus.
Default dark and light palettes are computationally verified to meet WCAG AA for text/muted on their surfaces (criterion 5).
`npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run test`, `npm run build` all pass.
verification: npm run test -> contrast/adjustForAA/resolveTokens unit tests, the default-palette AA assertions, and the esbuild parity test all pass
npm run build -> succeeds; dist/index.html inline bootstrap applies the correct theme before first paint (no flash)
Manual: toggle Light/Dark/System and set an accent; refresh and confirm it persists with no flash of the wrong theme
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. FEAT-001 had already shipped the esbuild bootstrap plugin (vite.config.ts), the parity test (src/lib/bootstrap-parity.test.ts, @vitest-environment node because esbuild can't start under jsdom), theme-core.ts (full API) and theme-core.test.ts; FEAT-004 added the runtime layer on top.

NEW FILES:
- src/lib/theme.ts: app-facing helpers that DO touch browser globals (kept OUT of theme-core so it stays esbuild-bundleable). Exports THEME_STORAGE_KEY='cb-theme' (same key+shape the inline bootstrap in vite.config.ts parses), prefersDark(), resolveActiveMode(prefs), applyTheme(prefs,mode) (sets data-mode + setProperty for every token), readStoredPrefs()/writeStoredPrefs() (JSON + normalizePrefs, try/catch for private-mode storage), subscribeToSystemMode(cb) (matchMedia addEventListener with legacy addListener fallback, no-op when matchMedia absent — jsdom has no matchMedia).
- src/context/ThemeProvider.tsx: source of truth after hydration. Hydrates synchronously from localStorage (readStoredPrefs ?? DEFAULT_PREFS) so React state matches the pre-paint result (no second resolve/flash). ALWAYS writes localStorage on change; if logged in ALSO update({theme_preferences}).eq('id',uid) (Policy A, role unchanged). On login reconciles ONCE per uid via a reconciledFor ref: DB wins when profile.themePreferences != defaults (isDefaultPrefs guard treats profile jsonb '{}' -> DEFAULT_PREFS as empty), else pushes localStorage up. Anonymous = localStorage only. 'system' mode subscribes to matchMedia and re-applies live. Exposes {prefs,setPrefs(patch),reset()}. setPrefs supports clearing tints via explicit undefined ('bgTint' in patch).
- src/components/ContrastWarning.tsx: role='status' advisory notice (NOT alert — nothing blocked), token-styled, optional {label,onClick} action for discard-tint.
- src/components/AppearancePanel.tsx (available to EVERYONE): Mode segmented control (aria-pressed), accent presets + <input type=color> + manual hex (draft state, validated on blur via isHex /^#([0-9a-fA-F]{6})$/, invalid rejected+keeps previous+role=alert hint), optional bg/surface TintControl (presets+picker+Clear), Reset to default. Contrast guards: computes resolveAccentText against the ACTIVE tinted bg/surface and shows the warning when it === base.text (fix #5 fallback); checks contrastRatio(base.text, tinted bg/surface) < AA and shows a discard-tint ContrastWarning. All controls real <button>/<input>.

WIRING: Header.tsx got a gear/palette <button aria-label='Appearance settings'> (inline SVG PaletteIcon, aria-hidden) that opens AppearancePanel in the existing Overlay; iconButtonStyle added. App.tsx now nests ThemeProvider between SessionProvider and Layout.

TESTS ADDED: src/lib/theme.test.ts (storage round-trip/normalize, applyTheme writes all tokens, resolveActiveMode with/without matchMedia via vi.stubGlobal, subscribe add/remove listener). src/lib/palette-aa.test.ts (criterion 5: DEFAULT dark+light --text/--muted clear AA on bg AND surface, --danger-contrast on --danger; resolveAccentText single-value-on-both + fallback-to-text). src/components/AppearancePanel.test.tsx (controls present, mode change, hex accept/reject, reset, discard-tint, accent-fallback warning) — mocks useTheme via vi.hoisted.

GOTCHAS for later FEATs: (1) adjustForAA DARKENS in light / LIGHTENS in dark, so a white accent only fails (stays white) in DARK mode; a white accent in LIGHT mode darkens to a readable gray and does NOT fall back — scenarios forcing the --text fallback must use dark mode + near-white tints. (2) The eslint config has NO type-aware rules, so @typescript-eslint/no-deprecated is unavailable — do not reference it in eslint-disable comments (hard error). (3) ThemeProvider emits the same react-refresh/only-export-components WARNING as SessionProvider (exports a hook beside the component) — accepted, non-blocking. (4) ThemeProvider depends on useSession, so component tests of anything under it must provide/mock both providers.

VERIFICATION: typecheck 0 errors; lint 0 errors (2 pre-existing fast-refresh warnings); test 79 passed + 9 RLS skipped (no live backend) incl. parity (5) + AA assertions; build succeeds and dist/index.html has the CBTheme IIFE + bootstrap stub in <head> at offset ~98, before the app script at ~5748 (no flash).
